This Unity Asset Pack Allows You to Add Interactive 2D and 3D Maps to Your Games

2026-08-24 Stephanie Almogabar, 80 Level Unity, Online Maps v5, Infinity Code, 2D maps, 3D maps, Mapbox, MapTiler, TomTom, HERE, game development, interactive maps
Read the source article

Quick summary

Infinity Code's Online Maps v5 Unity asset pack enables developers to embed fully customizable 2D and 3D interactive maps with routing, geocoding, GPS, and elevation data from 16+ providers including Mapbox, TomTom, HERE, and Google Maps into their game projects.

Key takeaways

  • Online Maps v5 supports 2D and 3D interactive maps with elevation on flat surfaces or an interactive globe
  • Elevation data sourced from HERE, Mapbox, MapTiler, and TomTom
  • Supports 16+ map providers with 88+ map types including Google Maps, Mapbox, ArcGIS, Bing Maps, and OpenStreetMap
  • Compatible with Built-in RP, URP, HDRP, and Custom RP; runs on standalone, Android, iOS, Windows Store, and WebGL
  • Includes raster and vector tiles with customizable Mapbox and MapTiler vector maps, 2D/3D/billboard markers, and built-in clustering
  • Full source code included with no dependencies, available at 50% discount
  • Powerful caching system for raster and vector tiles, elevations, and custom data
  • Supports WMS, WMTS, custom styles, and multilingual maps with or without labels
